centres.name: Kaplan International Pathways at the University of Victoria

programs.name: UVic Pathway Program
programs.progression: Bachelor's degree preparation; students complete first-year degree courses and start UVic studies; delivered by UVic English Language Centre

gaps: Fees: the Kaplan pages show 'From' total-course tuition for 2025-26 and 2026-27; the 2026-27 'From' figure is used throughout. UK fees are totals in GBP, not per term.

Durations are not stated on any UK Kaplan listing page (null) except University of York Foundation Certificate ('1.5-term') and UVic Pathway Program (11 months). Course info PDFs / summary sheets (downloads.kaplanpathways.com) were not read.
Intakes: UK pages only give three bands (Autumn Sep-Nov, Spring Jan-Apr, Summer May-Aug), not tied to programmes; Bristol IFP, Birmingham and York give more specific intakes where recorded.

English requirements are not stated per programme on UK listing pages (null). Only seen: KICL/ASU London page says UKVI IELTS 4.0-5.5 for degree preparation; Autumn 2025 summary sheet snippet says IELTS 5.5 overall (4.5 each skill) for Foundation Certificates - not verified on a page. Entry-requirements page https://www.kaplanpathways.com/how-to-apply/entry-requirements/uk/ was not fetched.

Fee set to null due to conflicting figures between Kaplan courses and fees pages: KICL Pre-Master's Science and Engineering 2026-27 (25,630 vs 26,630); Glasgow Foundation Business and Social Sciences 2026-27 (23,870 vs 23,170); Nottingham IYO Business (courses 23,260 vs fees page 18,990; 2025-26 24,240 vs 21,285).

York fees page shows inconsistent 2026-27 Pre-Master's figures (all 24,980); courses-page figures used instead. Brighton Pre-Master's fees page labels both columns 2025-26; courses-page 2026-27 figures used.

Kaplan International College London serves multiple partner universities (ASU London, City St George's, Cranfield, QMUL, NTU London, Birmingham, Bristol, Liverpool, Nottingham, Westminster, York); the programme-to-university mapping is not given in text, so progression is generic. Partner pages for these universities list KICL as an off-campus option; they are not separate centres.

Glasgow Pre-Master's also has an online route (Adam Smith Business School) and Kaplan offers online degree preparation; online/digital courses were out of scope and not collected. Pre-Doctorate (KICL, Nottingham) and Pre-Sessional English excluded.

Alberta Year One Foundation: tuition is per year and varies by faculty (CAD 35,908-49,952, 2026-27; full-degree tuition, not a separate foundation fee), so tuition_fee is null. Duration not stated as a standalone length.
